slides.teacher_cue: New r-controlled vowel — /ɜː/. Three spellings, one sound: er (her, fern), ir (bird, girl), ur (fur, burn). The r colours the vowel to make a mid-central sound — lips neutral, tongue mid, no rounding. Important upgrade: 'her' was a sight word. It is now fully decodable — h+er. Point this out and remove the underline in students' minds.
slides.expected_response: Students produce /ɜː/ cleanly across all three spellings and understand that er/ir/ur all make the same sound.
slides.correction_move: Show all three spelling cards: er, ir, ur — all make /ɜː/. Model each with words. Then confirm the upgrade: her = h + er — now decodable.
slides.observation_note: Watch for Korean learners producing a pure /ɜ/ without the r-colouring — the /ɜː/ needs the retroflex quality of /r/ at the end.

slides.teacher_cue: Say bird — ir spelling this time. Same /ɜː/ sound. Reveal and blend.
slides.expected_response: Students say bird orally and connect meaning before blending.
slides.correction_move: Model bird orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for /ɜː/ in ir — same sound as er in her.

slides.teacher_cue: Say girl — ir spelling. Confirm /ɜː/ and /l/ at end. Reveal and blend.
slides.expected_response: Students say girl orally and connect meaning before blending.
slides.correction_move: Model girl orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for /l/ vs /r/ in coda and /ɜː/ in ir.

slides.teacher_cue: Say fur — ur spelling this time. Same /ɜː/ sound. Reveal and blend.
slides.expected_response: Students say fur orally and connect meaning before blending.
slides.correction_move: Model fur orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for /p/ on /f/ and /ɜː/ in ur.

slides.teacher_cue: Say burn — to be on fire. ur spelling. Reveal and blend.
slides.expected_response: Students say burn orally and connect meaning before blending.
slides.correction_move: Model burn orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for /ɜː/ in ur and clear final /n/.

slides.teacher_cue: Say shirt — a piece of clothing. sh onset, ir vowel. Reveal and blend.
